resolved_findings.title: Footer bypasses CJK fallback after accepting its characters
resolved_findings.observed: The same release ID renders correctly in the Paragraph header, but its two CJK characters render as .notdef boxes in the footer. checked_text accepts them because CJK fallback has the glyphs; Canvas drawString is set only to DejaVu.
resolved_findings.smallest_fix: Use the same font-run fallback for the footer, or explicitly reject footer characters unavailable in its actual font. Add a focused regression assertion for footer font selection.
resolved_findings.impact: Current ASCII release ID unaffected; valid future input silently produces missing glyphs.
